findings.description: `marker_match` scans into subsequent findings if the current finding omits the `ADMISSIBILITY:` block. `re.search` scans the entire `finding_text` until it finds a match. If `finding_text` contains multiple findings (as evidenced by the comment on line 115 stating "the ADMISSIBILITY block consumes text from the subsequent finding"), and the first finding omits its admissibility block, `marker_match` will successfully match the `ADMISSIBILITY:` header of the *next* finding.
findings.proposed_fix:
<<<< SEARCH marker_match = re.search(
r"^\s*(?:#{1,6}\s*)?ADMISSIBILITY\s*:?\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*$",
        finding_text,
        re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if not marker_match:
        return list(ADMISSIBILITY_GATES)
==== REPLACE
# Prevent scanning into subsequent findings if the current one omits the block.
    next_finding = re.search(r"\n\s*FINDING_ID\s*:", finding_text)
    search_space = finding_text[:next_finding.start()] if next_finding else finding_text

    marker_match = re.search(
        r"^\s*(?:#{1,6}\s*)?ADMISSIBILITY\s*:?\s*(?:\([^)]*\))?\s*$",
        search_space,
        re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
    )
    if not marker_match:
        return list(ADMISSIBILITY_GATES)

findings.description:
Fix-interaction bug between C0010 (removed `$` from `marker_match`, allowing inline gate data in `tail`) and C0014 (added `^\s*` line-start anchor to gate pattern matching). The `marker_match` now accepts inline ADMISSIBILITY entries (e.g. `ADMISSIBILITY: S_min: PASS, G-completeness: PASS, ...`) and correctly puts the gate data into `tail`/`block`. But the gate-matching regex on line 114 (`r"^\s*" + pat + ...`) requires each gate name to appear at line-start (`^` in MULTILINE mode). In an inline format, only the first gate (at position 0 of `block`) matches `^`; all subsequent gates are mid-line and fail to match.

File: `_feedback_slice.py`, line 114.
Evidence: tool-verified test output:
parse_admissibility_block("ADMISSIBILITY: S_min: PASS, G-completeness: PASS, d_tool: PASS, σ_measured: N/A, q_retest: PASS\nNOVELTY:\n")
→ ['G-completeness', 'd_tool', 'σ_measured', 'q_retest']  # 4 false failures
findings.proposed_fix:
<<<< SEARCH bench/logs/exp40_slice_admissibility_hardened_20260518T190104Z/working/_feedback_slice.py
match = re.search(
                r"^\s*" + pat + r"\s*[:\-=]?\s*" + status_pattern,
                block,
                re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
            )
==== REPLACE
match = re.search(
                r"(?:^|[,;])\s*" + pat + r"\s*[:\-=]?\s*" + status_pattern,
                block,
                re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
            )
